<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>MAXIMUM — Turnkey sedation and anesthesia for dental clinics</title>
<meta name="description" content="We manage turnkey sedation and anesthesia for leading dental clinics across Canada.">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Instrument+Serif:ital@0;1&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=DM+Sans:opsz,wght@9..40,400;9..40,500;9..40,700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
  html, body { margin: 0; height: 100%; }
  body {
    font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif;
    color: #fff;
    background-color: #0A0A0A;
    background-image:
      repeating-linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(237,237,232,.022) 0 1px, transparent 1px 4px),
      linear-gradient(180deg, #2B2B2A 0%, #1C1C1C 28%, #111 60%, #0A0A0A 100%);
    background-attachment: fixed;
    -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  }
  a { color: #fff; text-decoration: none; }
  a:hover { color: #8E8E88; }

  .page { min-height: 100vh; min-height: 100svh; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }

  .bar { height: 76px; padding: 0 64px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(237,237,232,.12); }
  .logo { display: flex; }
  .logo img { height: 26px; width: auto; display: block; }
  .nav { display: flex; gap: 28px; font-size: 14px; }
  .menu-btn { display: none; width: 44px; height: 44px; padding: 0; background: none; border: 0; cursor: pointer; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; }
  .menu-btn span { width: 20px; height: 1px; background: #fff; display: block; transition: transform .2s; }

  .hero { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; padding: 56px 64px 60px; }
  h1 { margin: 0; font-weight: 500; font-size: 52px; line-height: 1.08; letter-spacing: -0.03em; max-width: 820px; text-wrap: balance; }
  h1 u { color: #fff; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-underline-offset: 0.14em; text-decoration-color: rgba(237,237,232,.6); }
  .ctas { margin-top: 40px; display: flex; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .btn { height: 40px; padding: 0 22px; border-radius: 2px; border: 0.5px solid rgba(237,237,232,.45); background: transparent; color: #fff; font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: .01em; white-space: nowrap; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; transition: border-color .2s, background .2s; }
  .btn:hover { color: #fff; border-color: rgba(237,237,232,.9); background: rgba(237,237,232,.04); }

  .partners { padding: 28px 64px; }
  .partners-label { font-size: 13px; color: #8E8E88; margin-bottom: 18px; }
  .marquee { overflow: hidden; -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #000 12%, #000 88%, transparent); mask-image: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #000 12%, #000 88%, transparent); }
  .track { display: flex; width: max-content; animation: mx-marquee 40s linear infinite; }
  .set { display: flex; gap: 48px; padding-right: 48px; }
  .tile { flex: none; height: 44px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
  .tile img { max-width: 100%; max-height: 100%; display: block; }
  .tile.placeholder { border: 0.5px dashed rgba(237,237,232,.28); border-radius: 2px; font-size: 12px; color: #8E8E88; letter-spacing: .04em; }
  @keyframes mx-marquee { from { transform: translateX(0); } to { transform: translateX(-50%); } }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .track { animation: none; } }

  footer { height: 72px; padding: 0 64px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; border-top: 1px solid rgba(237,237,232,.12); font-size: 12px; color: #8E8E88; }

  .foot-l { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
  .med { font-size: 22px; line-height: 1; color: #fff; font-family: 'Segoe UI Symbol','Apple Symbols','Noto Sans Symbols',sans-serif; }
  .copy { font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .02em; flex: none; }
  .phipa { font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.5; }
  .foot-r { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 28px; }
  .foot-r img { width: auto; display: block; opacity: .75; }
  .rcdso { height: 20px; } .rcpsc { height: 32px; }
  @media (max-width: 760px) {
    .bar { height: 64px; padding: 0 20px; position: relative; }
    .logo img { height: 20px; }
    .menu-btn { display: flex; }
    .nav { display: none; position: absolute; top: 64px; left: 0; right: 0; z-index: 10; flex-direction: column; gap: 0; padding: 8px 20px 20px; background: #111; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(237,237,232,.12); font-size: 22px; letter-spacing: -0.02em; }
    .nav a { padding: 12px 0; }
    .bar.open .nav { display: flex; }
    .bar.open .menu-btn span:first-child { transform: translateY(3.5px) rotate(45deg); }
    .bar.open .menu-btn span:last-child { transform: translateY(-3.5px) rotate(-45deg); }
    .hero { padding: 48px 20px 40px; }
    h1 { font-size: 32px; line-height: 1.1; }
    .ctas { margin-top: 28px; }
    .btn { flex: 1; height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; }
    .partners { padding: 20px 0; }
    .partners-label { font-size: 12px; margin: 0 20px 14px; }
    .track { animation-duration: 30s; }
    .set { gap: 24px; padding-right: 24px; }
    .tile { height: 36px; } .tile > * { zoom: .8; }
    footer { height: auto; padding: 18px 20px 22px; font-size: 11px; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 14px; } .med { font-size: 19px; } .foot-r { gap: 22px; } .rcdso { height: 16px; } .rcpsc { height: 26px; }
  }
</style>
</head>

          <div class="tile"><div style="display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:8px;color:#D6D6D0;white-space:nowrap"><span style="font-family:'Instrument Serif',serif;font-size:24px;line-height:1">Maple &amp; Main</span></div></div><div class="tile"><div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;color:#D6D6D0;white-space:nowrap"><span style="width:18px;height:1px;background:#D6D6D0;display:block"></span><span style="font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;font-weight:400;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:0.26em;line-height:1">KINGSWAY</span><span style="width:18px;height:1px;background:#D6D6D0;display:block"></span></div></div><div class="tile"><div style="font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:19px;letter-spacing:-0.045em;line-height:1;color:#D6D6D0;white-space:nowrap">Lakeshore Smile Co.</div></div>
        </div>
        <div class="set" aria-hidden="true">
          <div class="tile"><div style="font-family:'Instrument Serif',serif;font-style:italic;font-size:22px;line-height:1;color:#D6D6D0;white-space:nowrap">Harbourfront Dental</div></div><div class="tile"><div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:4px;color:#D6D6D0;white-space:nowrap"><span style="font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:0.32em;line-height:1">YORKVILLE</span><span style="font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;font-weight:400;font-size:8px;letter-spacing:0.42em;line-height:1">DENTAL STUDIO</span></div></div><div class="tile"><div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;color:#D6D6D0;white-space:nowrap"><span style="width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%;border:1.5px solid #D6D6D0;box-sizing:border-box;display:block"></span><span style="font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;font-weight:500;font-size:18px;letter-spacing:-0.03em;line-height:1">ridgeline dental</span></div></div>
          <div class="tile"><div style="display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:8px;color:#D6D6D0;white-space:nowrap"><span style="font-family:'Instrument Serif',serif;font-size:24px;line-height:1">Maple &amp; Main</span></div></div><div class="tile"><div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;color:#D6D6D0;white-space:nowrap"><span style="width:18px;height:1px;background:#D6D6D0;display:block"></span><span style="font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;font-weight:400;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:0.26em;line-height:1">KINGSWAY</span><span style="width:18px;height:1px;background:#D6D6D0;display:block"></span></div></div><div class="tile"><div style="font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:19px;letter-spacing:-0.045em;line-height:1;color:#D6D6D0;white-space:nowrap">Lakeshore Smile Co.</div></div>
